messages.content: Write a 100 word description of the Rocky Mountains.

message.content: The Rocky Mountains are a majestic stretch of jagged peaks and deep valleys extending over 3,000 miles from British Columbia in Canada down to New Mexico in the United States. Known for their breathtaking alpine scenery, the Rockies feature snow-capped summits, turquoise glacial lakes, and sprawling evergreen forests. This rugged wilderness is a sanctuary for diverse wildlife, including grizzly bears, elk, and bighorn sheep. As the Continental Divide, they shape the hydrology of North America. From thrilling ski slopes to serene hiking trails, the Rockies embody the raw, untamed beauty of the great outdoors.

Known for their breathtaking alpine scenery, the Rockies feature snow-capped summits, turquoise glacial lakes, and sprawling evergreen forests. From thrilling ski slopes to serene hiking trails, the Rockies embody the raw, untamed beauty of the great outdoors.
